meta.name: 10Y Realized Volatility (20d, ann.)
meta.notes: Annualized realized volatility of daily 10-year Treasury yield changes over the trailing 20 sessions, in basis points. A real, free stand-in for the licensed ICE MOVE index: MOVE is option-implied (forward-looking) vol, this is realized (backward-looking) vol, so it confirms rather than leads, but both spike on the same shocks.

impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates UP. A fall pushes them DOWN.

chains.chain: Rate volatility (10Y realized) → ↑ MBS spread → ↑ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: MBS are short an embedded prepayment option. Rate volatility makes that option more expensive, so investors demand more spread.
A wider spread raises the borrower rate even when Treasuries are unchanged.
